facts.business: Union Quality Plastics Limited manufactures HDPE/PP woven sacks and bags for packaging, primarily serving the fertilizer, cement, and food grain sectors.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company has successfully initiated its efforts for increasing exports and has set a target of exporting 80 % of its production.

auditor.name: Sagar & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Internal financial controls were operating effectively except for the matter prescribed in basis of qualified opinion para.

key_risks: Intense competition due to major petrochemical manufacturers making available cheap raw material abundantly
Volatility in raw material price due to crude price
facts.related_party_note: Pursuant to provisions of Schedule V (A) of SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, the compliance with Related Party Disclosure is given in notes to financial statement.
